title: Settlement Audit Trail | BackOfficeFleet
html:
Settlement proof

Trace the decision from delivery evidence through adjustment and closeout.

BOF connects the delivered work, POD and receipts, rate or pay basis, adjustments, questions, supporting evidence, owners, decisions, and changes in one settlement history.

Take the Assessment →

Source record

Load or work record, delivery proof, receipts, approved rate or pay inputs, deductions, advances, adjustments, dates, and responsible owners.

Review path

The history is checked for source match, chronology, evidence for adjustments, dispute state, ownership, approvals supplied by the fleet, and unresolved action.

Decision-ready output

A traceable settlement chronology with source evidence, changes, owners, decision state, and next action.

How the work moves

The record keeps the exception, owner, and consequence visible.

A reviewer can understand why a line changed or remains held without reconstructing the decision from email.

  1. 01

    Open the source record

    Load or work record, delivery proof, receipts, approved rate or pay inputs, deductions, advances, adjustments, dates, and responsible owners.

  2. 02

    Review the operating question

    The history is checked for source match, chronology, evidence for adjustments, dispute state, ownership, approvals supplied by the fleet, and unresolved action.

  3. 03

    Name the exception and owner

    Unresolved evidence is assigned to a responsible person with a clear request, review state, and condition that must be satisfied before the record moves.

  4. 04

    Carry the outcome forward

    A traceable settlement chronology with source evidence, changes, owners, decision state, and next action. A reviewer can understand why a line changed or remains held without reconstructing the decision from email.

Qualification

Administrative support stays inside a defined boundary.

BOF provides administrative traceability and does not determine legal entitlement, tax treatment, fiduciary duty, or payment authorization.

  • Public screens, records, statuses, and integration examples are static or synthetic unless a page explicitly states an authorized live capability.
  • The fleet, carrier, employer, agency, customer, and qualified professionals retain their operating, legal, safety, regulatory, and financial authority.
  • BOF does not guarantee release, acceptance, compliance, payment, collection, savings, audit, safety, or financial outcomes.
  • The BOF assessment qualifies the record set, responsible owner, service boundary, intended output, and appropriate next action.
